intro.title: Build request queue and priority controls
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a request queue system that manages incoming requests with different priority levels. You'll learn how to implement a queue data structure in JavaScript to control the order of request processing. The core programming concepts involve using arrays, objects, and conditional logic to handle priority-based sorting. You'll work with Node.js and JavaScript constructs like functions and loops to create a functional queue with basic controls. By the end, you'll have a working system that can add, prioritize, and process requests in a simulated environment.
intro.usecase: Request queues with priority controls are essential in production Node.js applications that handle high traffic or limited resources. For example, API gateways use priority queues to ensure critical authentication requests are processed before general data queries, while e-commerce platforms prioritize checkout requests over product browsing during peak sales. In microservices architectures, priority queues manage inter-service communication to prevent cascading failures by deprioritizing non-essential background tasks. Developers implement these controls in dashboard monitoring tools, payment processing systems, and real-time collaboration features where request ordering directly impacts user experience and system stability.
